title: Knit Health, which uses its AI world model to predict patient care needs, forecast treatment impacts, and optimize referrals, raised a $35M Series A led by NEA (Will Maddox/Axios)
summary: Will Maddox / Axios: Knit Health, which uses its AI world model to predict patient care needs, forecast treatment impacts, and optimize referrals, raised a $35M Series A led by NEA — Knit Health, a startup aiming to optimize patient referrals, raised a $35 million Series A round, CEO Jonathan Kolstad tells Axios Pro exclusively.
